name: const unsafe fn read < T > (src : * const T) -> T
rule: If `size_of::<T>()` is nonzero, the entire range of `size_of::<T>()` bytes starting at `src` must lie within the allocated object from which `src` is derived, as determined by its provenance; this is necessary but not always sufficient for read validity. Each stack-allocated variable is a separate allocated object.
api: const unsafe fn read < T > (src : * const T) -> T
